title: Ecological and evolutionary diversification of LuxI/R quorum sensing and LuxR solo regulators in Pseudomonas.
authors: Al-Darwish, Hashem; Ezzahidi, Oumaima; Achouak, Wafa; Diab, Elmahdi; Ait El Aouad, Hayat; Essamdi, Ouissal; Sollitto, Marco; Bez, Cristina; Venturi, Vittorio
one_liner_zh: 该文对假单胞菌属LuxI/R群体感应系统及LuxR solo调控因子进行比较基因组与AlphaFold3结构分析，虽涉及蛋白-DNA互作（LuxR为DNA结合转录因子）及结构建模，但核心是生态进化与基因组分布，非TF-DNA结合机制或AI/物理模拟方法研究，仅部分方法可借鉴。
abstract: Bacterial quorum sensing (QS) is classically viewed as a population-density-dependent communication system mediated by canonical LuxI/R circuits. However, increasing evidence indicates that QS is also shaped by environmental and ecological contexts and that its regulatory architectures extend beyond canonical systems via the diversification of LuxR solo regulators lacking cognate LuxI synthases. Here, we performed a comprehensive comparative genomic analysis of 1,740 chromosome-level genomes across the genus Pseudomonas in order to investigate the distribution, organization, evolutionary diversification and ecological associations of LuxI/R QS systems and LuxR solos. We show that complete LuxI/R systems are patchily distributed across the genus, indicating that canonical N-acyl homoserine lactone-mediated QS is not a universally conserved trait in Pseudomonas. Instead, LuxI/R systems display strong lineage-dependent retention patterns, with selective expansion in specific taxa and recurrent absence in many others, suggesting dynamic evolutionary gain, loss and diversification. Phylogenetic analyses further revealed weak lineage constraint and evidence of both vertical inheritance and horizontal transfer. In contrast, LuxR solos are pervasive and frequently expanded, particularly in environmental and plant-associated species. Phylogenetic and AlphaFold3-guided structural analyses of LuxR solo ligand-binding domains revealed potential diversification of predicted signal response, suggesting possible broad evolution of ligand-recognition capabilities. Multiple LuxR solos within single genomes frequently occupied distinct phylogenetic and structural clades, possibly indicating that they are unlikely to be functionally redundant and this leads us to speculate that they could mediate responses to diverse environmental, microbial or host-derived signals. Ecological analyses further demonstrated that expansion of canonical LuxI/R systems appears to be associated primarily with rhizosphere-associated lifestyles, whereas LuxR solo diversification correlates with intimate plant-associated niches. Together, these findings indicate that QS-related evolution in Pseudomonas is characterized less by conservation of canonical signalling circuits and more by diversification via LuxR solos, expanding the ecological adaptability and communication potential of these bacteria.
abstract_zh: 细菌群体感应（quorum sensing, QS）经典上被视为一种由典型LuxI/R回路介导的、依赖种群密度的通讯系统。然而，越来越多的证据表明，QS也受环境和生态背景的影响，其调控架构通过缺乏同源LuxI合酶的LuxR solo调控因子的多样化而超越典型系统。在此，我们对假单胞菌属（Pseudomonas）中1,740个染色体水平基因组进行了全面的比较基因组分析，以研究LuxI/R QS系统和LuxR solos的分布、组织、进化多样化及生态关联。我们表明，完整的LuxI/R系统在该属中呈斑块状分布，指示典型的N-酰基高丝氨酸内酯介导的QS并非假单胞菌属中的普遍保守性状。相反，LuxI/R系统表现出强烈的谱系依赖性保留模式，在特定类群中选择性扩展，并在许多其他类群中反复缺失，提示动态的进化获得、丢失和多样化。系统发育分析进一步揭示了较弱的谱系约束，以及垂直遗传和水平转移的证据。相比之下，LuxR solos普遍存在且频繁扩展，尤其在环境和植物相关物种中。对LuxR solo配体结合域的系统发育和AlphaFold3引导的结构分析揭示了预测信号响应的潜在多样化，提示配体识别能力可能存在广泛进化。单个基因组中的多个LuxR solos常占据不同的系统发育和结构分支，可能表明它们不太可能功能冗余，这使我们推测它们可能介导对多种环境、微生物或宿主来源信号的响应。生态分析进一步表明，典型LuxI/R系统的扩展主要与根际相关生活方式相关联，而LuxR solo多样化则与紧密的植物相关生态位相关。综合这些发现，假单胞菌属中与QS相关的进化特征较少表现为典型信号回路的保守性，而更多表现为通过LuxR solos的多样化，从而扩展了这些细菌的生态适应性和通讯潜力。
